events.quote: On 5 May 1905 , she married William Morris Thomas , becoming Mary Thomas .

events.text: Mary returned to Perth.

events.text: Mary Thomas bought her first business, the Bon Ton Cafe on William Street.

events.text: Thomas established Metropolitan Properties Ltd with a capital value of £100,000.

events.text: She bought the Gordons Hotel for £40,000 and obtained her first liquor licence.

events.quote: That same year she bought the Gordons Hotel for £40,000

events.text: She surrendered the lease after two years.

events.text: Thomas was informed that the Wentworth Hotel was to be requisitioned by the United States Navy, and she ceded control of most of the hotels running to them.

events.text: Mary Thomas married Arnold Yeldham (known as Joe) Raine.

events.object: Arnold Yeldham ( known as Joe ) Raine
events.quote: On 3 December 1943 , Mary Thomas married Arnold Yeldham ( known as Joe ) Raine

events.text: Mary inherited Joe's estate, worth £153,906, and donated it to the University of Western Australia to establish the Arnold Yeldham and Mary Raine Medical Research Foundation.
events.subject: self
events.object: Arnold Yeldham and Mary Raine Medical Research Foundation
events.quote: On 11 February 1957 he suffered a cerebral haemorrhage and died . He was buried at Karrakatta Cemetery . Mary inherited Joes estate , worth £153,906 , and donated it to the University of Western Australia

events.text: Raine made a new will, leaving the bulk of her estate to the University.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1957 Raine made a new will

events.text: She signed a deed of trust with the University to specify how the estate was to be used after her death.
